title: TableCodex Sync
description: Production-grade session telemetry capture, combat reconstruction, and export/sync for TableCodex. D&D5e-first, with optional Midi-QOL enrichment.

recommends.reason: Enables high-fidelity attack/damage/save telemetry when present (optional).

systems.reason: Phase 3 activity/spell/weapon/feature/resource telemetry is D&D5e-specific. Core telemetry (HP, movement, conditions, combat, rolls) is system-agnostic.
